Package org.tasktide.engine.executor.streamhandler

Class StreamHandler

java.lang.Object
org.tasktide.engine.executor.streamhandler.StreamHandler
public class StreamHandler extends Object
Stdout and Stderr log stream handler for ProcessExecutor. Logs lt 1MB stored in DB, otherwise zipped and recorded in DB. Functional Interface and LogTarget could help with sinking to say CloudWatch etc
